facts.text: Hayman Island sits at the northernmost point of the Whitsunday archipelago in Australia.
facts.excerpt: Hayman Island is nestled at the northernmost point of Australia

facts.text: The Infinity Pool overlooks the Coral Sea.
facts.excerpt: an Infinity Pool overlooking the Coral Sea

facts.text: The Hayman Pool is the largest saltwater pool in the southern hemisphere.
facts.excerpt: the iconic Hayman Pool which is the largest saltwater pool in the southern hemisphere

facts.text: The Hayman Residences on the island hillside were designed by Australian architect Kerry Hill and offer panoramic views across the Whitsundays.
facts.excerpt: Designed by multi-award-winning Australian Architect Kerry Hill, all Residences offer panoramic views across The Whitsundays.

facts.text: Accommodation ranges across rooms, suites, pavilions, villas, residences and the three-bedroom Hayman Beach House.
facts.excerpt: beautifully-appointed rooms, suites, pavilions, villas, residences and the three-bedroom Hayman Beach House

facts.text: Hayman Spa has treatment rooms, a couples' room, and sauna and steam facilities set in the natural surrounds of Hayman Island.
facts.excerpt: a couples' room, sauna and steam facilities nestled in the natural surrounds of Hayman Island

facts.text: The resort offers helicopter adventures over Heart Reef and helicopter tours over Whitehaven Beach.
facts.excerpt: offers bespoke helicopter adventures that take you high above the world-famous Heart Reef, and exhilarating helicopter tours over Whitehaven Beach and beyond

facts.text: Heart Reef is best experienced from the air by helicopter, as visitors cannot snorkel or dive there because of its protected status.
facts.excerpt: Heart Reef is best experienced from the air by helicopter through our partner, Helireef, as visitors are unable to snorkel or dive there due it's protected status

facts.text: Guests can travel by resort speedboat to Langford Island, where a sand spit at low tide gives access to fringing coral reefs.
facts.excerpt: Travel by resort speedboat to Langford Island and spend a couple of hours exploring this natural wonder.

facts.text: Signature dining experiences include Under the Stars dining on Hayman Beach, gourmet picnics in secluded beach locations and private poolside cabana lunches.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in Under the Stars dining on Hayman Beach, secluded gourmet picnics in idyllic beach locations, private poolside cabana lunches, and more.

facts.text: Pacific, the resort's signature restaurant and bar, is on the beachfront in the Central Lanai.
facts.excerpt: Pacific is located on the beachfront in the Central Lanai

facts.text: Poolside Cabanas near the Infinity Pool and Hayman Pool offer ocean views and sundeck space.
facts.excerpt: the Poolside Cabanas are an ideal private abode with contemporary comfort, ocean views, and sundeck space

facts.text: The fitness centre has a dedicated group fitness area offering Pilates, yoga and meditation classes.
facts.excerpt: a dedicated group fitness area offering Pilates, yoga, and meditation classes

facts.text: The resort has an indoor golf simulator.
facts.excerpt: state of the art indoor golf simulator

facts.text: The resort is located in a national park, so no pets are permitted; guide dogs and service animals are exempt.
facts.excerpt: As InterContinental Hayman Great Barrier Reef is located in a national park, no pets are permitted at the Resort.

facts.text: The nearest airport is Hamilton Island - Great Barrier Reef Airport, about 35 kilometers from the resort.
facts.excerpt: conveniently located near Hamilton Island - Great Barrier Reef Airport (HTI), approximately 21.75 miles away (35 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.text: The resort is a single-use plastic free hotel.
Babysitting, a nanny for hire and children's activities are available.
The hotel describes Whitehaven Beach as regarded one of the world's most beautiful beaches.
facts.excerpt: regarded one of the world's most beautiful beaches with crystal-white silica sand
